gloss: taking a story with a grain of salt; believing only half of what is said

definitions.gloss: taking a story with a grain of salt; believing only half of what one is told
definitions.explanation: The attitude of listening to a story while assuming much of it is exaggeration, so one believes only about half. Most often used in the phrase {話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}に{聞|き}く.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: to take what one hears with a grain of salt

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自慢話|じまんばなし}→自慢話：29001_jimanbanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: His bragging is best taken at half value.

examples.japanese: うわさ{話|ばなし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You'd do well to take rumors with a grain of salt.

notes:
Literally 'half of the story.' Implies that a story is probably half exaggeration, so only half should be believed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen with a grain of salt
- {話|はなし}{半分|はんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧: it's about right to believe only half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{眉唾|まゆつば}→眉唾：28820_mayutsuba⟧: dubious, fishy — emphasizes that a claim itself is suspect, rather than how one should listen to it
